auditSeams: OpenMem uses the classic FScanner: a bare semicolon or // comments out the rest of the line, and a quoted semicolon is the token Compare(";") can match. Skill count is the host AllSkills size. DF_NO_MONSTERS is 1<<12. ChangeLevel and give commands are recorded on the host. VmFScriptCmd stays untouched.
auditRationale: UNCredited t_cmd.cpp 1–186 (+186). Chunk 858 retired this file with empty native ranges. The file ends at 186. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.

auditManagedLocJustification: FS_EmulateCmd and FS_MapCmd call FScanner (OpenMem, GetString, Compare, MustGetNumber, MustGetFloat) and strtoull. That scanner is classic mode: semicolon and // comments, block comments, quoted strings, and base-0 integers. Those calls sit inside this band, and the retired VmFScriptCmd port treats a bare semicolon as a token and uses 4 for DF_NO_MONSTERS, so this slice cannot wrap it. The extra managed lines are that scanner and the hex color parse.

Give rewrites a Legacy prefix before the %.72s format. Shotgun is tested before supershotgun, and map is tested before fullmap. Map starts from reset-inventory and reset-health, adds no-monsters only when dmflags has 1<<12, clamps the skill with the host skill count, and copies at most eight map characters. A bare semicolon comments out the rest of the line. A quoted semicolon stops a gimme list or a skip loop. Map reads until the scanner ends, so it consumes a following command. Fog density is integer number*70/400 and does not skip, but a following gravity command is still inside gravity's own skip once gravity runs. A bad float aborts the command.
